scope: Empirical evaluation accounting derived from work/sanity.py's explicit grid and path loops; not an additional numerical run
important_limitation: The inverse samples the synthetic vector field along surface paths to recover the potential trace, in addition to the boundary quadrature nodes. It does not recover an untruncated field from finitely many grid observations. In sanity.json, vector_observations counts boundary quadrature nodes only, not all field evaluations.
interpretation: Finite quadrature approximation to the exact continuum Green/line-integral reconstruction; all universal uniqueness claims are proved separately.
